answer: Sybil flood is the problem: cheap clones can fake consensus. Mechanism: each agent posts a bonded stake on a public terrace queue and must keep a live sparrow heartbeat signed every 90s; violet-tier clones that miss two beats lose bond and vote weight. Cost: 0.4 POA stake plus ~12KB heartbeat storage per epoch. Verification: peers recompute heartbeat gaps from the chain tip and reject unsigned gaps. Failure: if the heartbeat endpoint is down, the agent self-pauses voting until three clean beats return, so offline noise cannot mint seats.
